binance.basis: Existing V0.1 frozen 8h cadence; archive metadata funding_interval_hours must equal 8 for every row

hyperliquid.basis: Hyperliquid documented funding payment cadence is hourly

source_semantics.normalization_rule: Assign each raw event timestamp to the unique nearest nominal UTC funding slot. Assignment fails closed if distance is >= half the nominal interval.
source_semantics.coverage_rule: A UTC month is complete only when every expected nominal slot exists exactly once after normalization, with zero missing slots and zero duplicate normalized slots.

rationale: The V0.1 raw max-gap test treated millisecond/second publication jitter as missing funding events. V0.4 changes only timestamp semantics from raw wall-clock gap equality to exact nominal-slot occupancy; it does not reduce required event count or permit missing slots.
decision_rule: PASS requires at least one common full UTC month under exact nominal-slot occupancy across all four frozen series. No Discovery or trading is authorized automatically.
